context:
(a) After `up --wait` returns 0, settle for a configurable docker_settle_s
(default 10), run compose ps, and fail the platform block if any service is
Exited or Restarting; then TCP-probe via the existing host_reachability_endpoint.
Route the failure into the startup_failed path execute.py already models, so the
remaining stacks still run and the cells are not miscounted as failures.
(b) Add preflight.free_memory_min_gib mirroring free_space_min_gib, including the
0-disables convention, and log engine, host free memory and per-platform VM
request to uat_lifecycle.log.
description:
Supersedes uat-container-readiness-and-memory-headroom-gate, dropped the same day: verification ladders are
create-time-only in this tracker, so a lint finding on a rung can only be
fixed by recreating the item.

Two independent defects that combined to waste a full sweep.

(a) FALSE-POSITIVE READINESS. compose_up_command issues
`up -d --wait --wait-timeout <n>` and tests/uat/phases/execute.py treats exit 0 as
'platform is up'. OBSERVED 2026-08-04: mocker reported CedarDB Started, and
`mocker compose ps` showed diag-net-cedardb-1 Exited roughly 29 seconds later.
UAT then ran 171 cells against a dead stack; all 171 failed on connection errors
and were recorded as cell failures rather than as a startup failure.

(b) NO MEMORY GATE. Preflight gates free DISK (free_space_min_gib) but not free
MEMORY. Under mocker each container is its own VM with independent memory sizing.
Container log from the same run:
  Running under cgroup memory limit: 1024 MB (host has 1112 MB)
  WARNING: io_uring_register_buffers: Bad address
  FATAL: unable to register fixed io_uring buffer
Host state: 72 MB free of 16 GB, 11.7 of 13.3 GB swap used. The root cause was
host memory exhaustion, NOT a mocker defect -- an important correction to the
initial diagnosis, which wrongly proposed abandoning mocker.

anti_patterns.dont: conclude that mocker is broken and switch the release gate to docker
anti_patterns.instead: gate on memory headroom and verify readiness after start
anti_patterns.why: this was investigated on 2026-08-04 and the root cause was host memory exhaustion; mocker was previously validated at real cost and switching would discard that work while leaving the missing gate in place

anti_patterns.dont: count cells against a stack that failed its readiness check as cell failures
anti_patterns.instead: record startup_failed and mark the platform's cells skipped-unreachable
anti_patterns.why: that is exactly what produced the misleading 171/171 result and hid the real cause

anti_patterns.dont: gate on total RAM instead of currently free memory
anti_patterns.instead: gate on measured free memory with swap pressure logged alongside
anti_patterns.why: the failing host had 16 GB total and 72 MB free; total capacity says nothing about headroom

anti_patterns.dont: raise docker_start_timeout_s in response to these failures
anti_patterns.instead: add a post-start settle plus compose ps state check
anti_patterns.why: the container reported Started and then died -- a longer timeout waits longer for something already reported healthy

deferrals.reason: w0's _check_docker_platform_readiness calls sleep_fn(cleanup.docker_settle_s) and run_execute defaults sleep_fn to time.sleep with docker_settle_s=10. Every test_phases.py call site in the w0 work adds sleep_fn=lambda _s: None; the run_execute call in tests/uat/test_sweep_durability.py::test_interrupt_mid_cell_still_tears_down_docker_stack does not, so that test will pass but sleep a real 10s per run. Could not be fixed ahead of w0 because run_execute does not accept sleep_fn on develop today. The docker-verb half of this fixture is already fixed on branch claude/strange-hertz-5938fa.

Verified by wall clock -- tests/uat/ drops from 16.2s to 8.0s with the whole suite green (612 passed).

It is unreachable: no local or remote branch or tag contains it (git for-each-ref --contains and git branch -a --contains both return nothing), no checked-out worktree HEAD descends from it, git rev-list --all --children lists no children, and neither docker_settle_s nor free_memory_min_gib exists anywhere under tests/ on origin/develop. No PR was ever opened for it. Only reflog entries currently keep the object alive, so it is gc-eligible once those expire. Whoever claims this item should verify the commit still resolves and recover it (branch at that SHA, rebase onto develop) rather than reimplementing w0/w1/w2 from scratch.

preserves.behavior: A single platform's startup failure still does not abort the sweep (uat-docker-stack-recovery w2 behavior).
Exactly one docker stack runs at a time; parallel_platforms stays hard-rejected.
UAT never runs docker system/volume/image prune or unqualified compose down; only project-scoped teardown.
free_space_min_gib: 0 keeps disabling the disk gate; free_memory_min_gib: 0 disables the memory gate the same way.
resolve_container_cli precedence is unchanged: env override, then mocker-if-present on macOS, then docker.

prior_art.concept: tcp_probe plus docker_assets.host_reachability_endpoint already implement host-side reachability; reuse for the post-start check

startup_failed handling already records a platform's cells as skipped-unreachable and advances to the next stack (uat-docker-stack-recovery w2); route the new readiness failure into it rather than adding a parallel path
existing disk budget gate establishes the config surface, the 0-disables convention and the lifecycle log shape; the memory gate mirrors it
